articles.title: WhatsApp is a 'lifeline' for refugees. Advocates fear it could be severed in fight over federal bill
articles.summary: Meta said this week that Bill C-22 could force it to "consider" withdrawing encrypted services like WhatsApp from Canada. Rights advocates say that would cut refugees and other newcomers off from a key platform they rely on to get information and stay connect…
